item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We must prevent anyone from building it.

2. We are not calling for safer superintelligence. We are calling for a ban. If it is built within the next 20 years, the resulting catastrophe will kill at least a billion people.

3. No company or country should be permitted to build superintelligent AI. If anyone builds it within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 115 words

If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We are stating this plainly because the stakes leave no room for euphemism. Today’s AI systems are already advancing toward capabilities their creators do not fully understand or control, and scaling current techniques will not produce a safe, obedient mind. It will produce a power beyond humanity’s ability to contain. That is why we are working for a ban on superintelligence—not a pause, voluntary guidelines, or promises of better testing. The necessary line is simple: no one should build it. Our future depends on making that line law before it is too late.
